title: Orbital
synopsis: A lyrical meditation on Earth and humanity through the eyes of six astronauts and cosmonauts over sixteen sunrises and sunsets aboard the International Space Station.

title: Prophet Song
synopsis: A chilling portrait of a mother fighting to protect her family as Ireland descends into totalitarianism, told in relentless, breathless paragraphs.

title: The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida
synopsis: A mordant, afterlife mystery following a dead war photographer who has seven moons to solve his murder and lead his loved ones to photographs that will rock Sri Lanka.

title: The Promise
synopsis: Charting the decline of a white South African family over four decades through four funerals, defined by an unkept promise made to their Black domestic servant.

title: Shuggie Bain
synopsis: Set in working-class 1980s Glasgow, an intimate and heart-wrenching story of a young boy's fierce love for his proud, alcoholic mother.

title: Girl, Woman, Other
synopsis: A vibrant polyphonic tapestry tracing the intertwined lives and struggles of twelve primarily Black British women across decades and social classes.

title: The Testaments
synopsis: Picking up fifteen years after Offred stepped into the unknown, the explosive sequel to The Handmaid's Tale reveals Gilead's inner workings through three distinct testimonies.

title: Lincoln in the Bardo
synopsis: An extraordinary polyphonic theatrical novel set in a Georgetown cemetery over a single night in 1862, where the spirit of Abraham Lincoln's recently deceased son Willie lingers.

title: Wolf Hall
synopsis: A masterclass in historical imagination tracing the rise of Thomas Cromwell in the perilous, mercurial court of King Henry VIII.

title: The Underground Railroad
synopsis: A devastating, inventive reimagining in which the antebellum Underground Railroad is not a metaphor, but a secret subterranean network of tracks, conductors, and steam engines.

title: The Nickel Boys
synopsis: Based on the real atrocities at the Dozier School in Florida, following two Black boys sentenced to a hellish juvenile reformatory during the Jim Crow era.

title: Demon Copperhead
synopsis: A contemporary Appalachian reimagining of David Copperfield, charting an orphaned boy's survival through poverty, foster care, addiction, and athletic glory.

title: Trust
synopsis: An elegant puzzle-box novel that interrogates wealth, deception, and power across four competing versions of a 1920s Wall Street financier and his brilliant wife.

title: Night Watch
synopsis: A richly rendered Civil War saga set in the aftermath of the conflict, following a traumatized mother and daughter finding sanctuary inside a West Virginia lunatic asylum.

title: The Netanyahus
synopsis: A biting campus comedy and intellectual tour de force chronicling the arrival of Benzion Netanyahu and his disruptive young family at an upstate New York college in 1959.

title: The Night Watchman
synopsis: Based on the life of Erdrich's grandfather, a night watchman at a jewel-bearing plant who led the Chippewa resistance against federal termination legislation in 1953.

title: The Overstory
synopsis: A sweeping epic that intertwines the lives of nine distinct strangers summoned by trees to combat the destruction of North America's virgin forests.

title: Sing, Unburied, Sing
synopsis: A haunting road trip through contemporary Mississippi as a fractured family travels to pick up a father released from Parchman Farm penitentiary, shadowed by ancestral ghosts.

title: Blackouts
synopsis: An inventive dialogue and erasure collage between a young narrator and an aging man dying in a desert hospice, excavating suppressed twentieth-century queer history.

title: The Rabbit Hutch
synopsis: Over a scorching July week in a decaying Indiana post-industrial town, the trapped residents of an affordable apartment complex careen toward a climactic act of violence.

title: Hell of a Book
synopsis: A wildly imaginative, satirical journey of a Black author on a cross-country publicity tour who is accompanied by an invisible child and hallucinations.

title: Interior Chinatown
synopsis: Written in the format of a television screenplay, satirizing Hollywood stereotypes through Willis Wu, a background actor trapped playing 'Generic Asian Man'.

title: Brotherless Night
synopsis: Set during the onset of the Sri Lankan civil war, recounting a young Tamil woman aspiring to be a doctor who gets swept into moral crisis and underground reporting.

title: The Book of Form and Emptiness
synopsis: After the tragic loss of his father, fourteen-year-old Benny starts hearing the voices of inanimate objects, finding sanctuary in a public library where books speak with him.

title: Piranesi
synopsis: Piranesi lives in the House, an infinite labyrinth of halls lined with thousands of statues and surging ocean tides, until a sinister second visitor disturbs his solitary peace.

title: Hamnet
synopsis: A tender reimagining of Shakespeare's domestic life in 1590s Warwickshire, centering on Agnes Hathaway and the devastating loss of their eleven-year-old son to the plague.

title: Kairos
synopsis: A claustrophobic, doomed romance between an older married writer and a young student in 1980s East Berlin, mirrored by the crumbling collapse of East Germany.

title: Time Shelter
synopsis: A 'clinic for the past' cures Alzheimer's by recreating past decades in meticulous detail, but soon entire European nations hold referendums on which decade to live in.

title: Tomb of Sand
synopsis: An 80-year-old Indian matriarch sinks into deep depression after her husband's death, then gains an unexpected new lease on life and insists on traveling to Pakistan to confront the past.

title: The Vegetarian
synopsis: A modern South Korean woman's decision to stop eating meat provokes vicious family and societal outrage, escalating into a surreal metamorphosis.

title: A Memory Called Empire
synopsis: Ambassador Mahit Dzmare arrives in the heart of the multi-system Teixcalaanli Empire to discover her predecessor was murdered, threatening her independent mining station.

title: The Fifth Season
synopsis: On the supercontinent of the Stillness, a civilization shaped by periodic extinction-level seismic seasons is brought to its knees when a vast rift is torn through the world.

title: Ducks, Newburyport
synopsis: Composed almost entirely of a single, breath-taking thousand-page sentence, an Ohio mother and baker ruminates on pie crusts, family, mass shootings, and environmental dread.

title: Solenoid
synopsis: A failed poet teaching in Communist Bucharest inhabits a house built atop a gigantic underground electrical coil (solenoid) that produces anti-gravity and dimensional tears.
